comparisonPolicy: Exact rational predictions from original raw decimal strings; no tolerance, observed-cell rounding, fitted algorithm or transparency quantizer. RGB conversions and alpha packing remain separate frozen hypotheses.
precisionBoundary: SUPPORTED denotes equality for the captured exported strings under that explicitly named model, not recovery of hidden internal precision or an unbounded algorithm. Integer-scale contrary RGB/T/NA values remain observed refutations.
residualScope: No RSI seed/primitive or synthetic-harness equivalence claim
